# Lucide plugin icons

SVG paths from https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide at commit `500620a2e8123f8d1db191538886dc0c223f69a9`.

The names in `icons.json` are supported by Tomo plugin manifests. Icons render
locally with `currentColor`; there is no CDN request or client library required.
Upstream ISC and Feather MIT license notices are preserved in LICENSE.
